result.markdown:
# Incident Report: S-SUD-002 Outage

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SUD-01-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct alarm evidence on the fiber link and affected sites perfectly matches the timing of the KPI drop, and maintenance, changes, and external events were explicitly checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-05 21:00 to 2026-09-06 02:53
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-05 21:00
- **Affected:** S-SUD-002, S-SUD-008, LNK-SUD-01-B

## Summary

Fiber link loss (LINK_LOS) on LNK-SUD-01-B causing S-SUD-002 and sibling site S-SUD-008 to go down.

Site S-SUD-002 experienced an outage starting at 21:00 on 2026-09-05 and recovered automatically at 02:53 on 2026-09-06 when the underlying transport link recovered.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-05 21:00: Critical LINK_LOS raised on fiber link LNK-SUD-01-B [ALM-000096, T3]
- 2026-09-05 21:01: Critical SITE_DOWN raised on S-SUD-002 and sibling site S-SUD-008 [ALM-000097, ALM-000098, T3]
- 2026-09-06 02:32: Software upgrade patch applied on CORE-UPF-02 [CHG-2026-0012, T5]
- 2026-09-06 02:52: LINK_LOS cleared on LNK-SUD-01-B [ALM-000096, T3]
- 2026-09-06 02:53: SITE_DOWN cleared on S-SUD-002 [ALM-000097, T3]
- 2026-09-06 02:54: SITE_DOWN cleared on S-SUD-008 [ALM-000098, T3]

## Evidence

- S-SUD-002 experienced an anomaly starting at 21:00 on 2026-09-05 affecting availability and user traffic. [T1, ANM-000090, ANM-000091, ANM-000092]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on fiber link LNK-SUD-01-B at 21:00, leading to SITE_DOWN alarms on S-SUD-002 and S-SUD-008 at 21:01. [ALM-000096, ALM-000097, ALM-000098, T3]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the site, parent link, aggregation router, or its ancestors during the incident window. [T4]
- No external events were recorded for the region during the incident window. [T8]
- A software upgrade on CORE-UPF-02 occurred at 02:32 on 2026-09-06, which is hours after the outage started and cannot be the cause. [CHG-2026-0012, T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-01-B: confirmed. Direct evidence of a fiber link loss (LINK_LOS) on LNK-SUD-01-B exactly matching the onset of the site outages, which cleared automatically when transport recovered. [ALM-000096, ALM-000097, ALM-000098, T3]
2. **bad_change** at CORE-UPF-02: rejected. The software upgrade on CORE-UPF-02 occurred at 02:32, hours after the outage started at 21:00. [CHG-2026-0012, T5]
3. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SUD-01-B: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled for the affected nodes. [T4]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0012: Occurred at 02:32 on 2026-09-06, which is over 5 hours after the outage began at 21:00 on 2026-09-05.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-SUD-01-B physical integrity to determine why the transient LOS occurred.
